d:
Mokama ke purv vidhayak aur bahubli neta anant sinh (chhote sarkar) ke aavas par vivah aur janeoo sanskar samaroh ki taiyariyan behad teji se antim charan men pahunch chuki hain. ABP nyuj ki vishesh graund riport men shadi aur janeoo sanskar sthal ke ek-ek kone ka jayja liya gaya.
Ghar ke andar hi bana 1 kattha men bhavy mandap
